facts.en: Completed a diploma in Library Services at Fictional Institute D047 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D047 完成图书馆服务专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a public-programmes assistant at Fictional Reading Centre D047 from 2021-09 to 2026-07.
facts.zh: 2021-09 至 2026-07 在虚构阅读中心 D047 担任公共项目助理。

facts.en: Booked rooms and maintained registration lists for reading groups and practical workshops.
facts.zh: 为阅读小组和实践工作坊预订房间并维护报名名单。

facts.en: Used shared calendars, spreadsheet validation and approved email templates for participant reminders.
facts.zh: 使用共享日历、电子表格验证及获批邮件模板发送参与者提醒。

facts.en: With the centre coordinator, trialed a check-in desk layout across 6 workshops in 2025-05.
facts.zh: 在 2025-05 与中心协调员合作，在 6 场工作坊试行签到台布局。

facts.en: Across 90 timed check-ins in those workshops, median waiting time was 3 minutes versus 5 minutes in 90 observations from the preceding 6 workshops; staffing also changed.
facts.zh: 在这些工作坊计时的 90 次签到中，等待时间中位数为 3 分钟，之前 6 场工作坊的 90 次观察为 5 分钟；人员配置亦有变化。

facts.en: Requested accessibility preferences on approved forms and referred accommodation decisions to the coordinator.
facts.zh: 通过获批表格收集无障碍需求，并将便利措施决定转交协调员。

facts.en: Prepared an event-day run sheet for a 2026-03 fictional local history afternoon that was held as scheduled.
facts.zh: 为 2026-03 一场虚构地方历史主题下午活动准备当天流程表；活动如期举行。

facts.en: Drafted an outdoor storytelling-festival concept in 2026-06; no venue permit or supplier booking was obtained.
facts.zh: 2026-06 起草户外故事节构想；未取得场地许可或预订供应商。

facts.en: Coordinated task assignments for 9 volunteers at the 2026-03 event; regular weekly sessions used 2 volunteers in 2026-07.
facts.zh: 在 2026-03 活动中协调 9 名志愿者的任务；2026-07 常规每周活动使用 2 名志愿者。

facts.en: Separately volunteered at Fictional Garden Group V047 on alternate Sundays from 2023-04 to 2024-10 while retaining the centre job.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2024-10 保留中心岗位期间，隔周星期日在虚构园艺团体 V047 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the garden group, maintained seed-swap inventory rather than managing a public event budget.
facts.zh: 为园艺团体维护种子交换库存，并非管理公共活动预算。

facts.en: Makes paper-cut decorations as a hobby; no paid design work is claimed.
facts.zh: 以剪纸装饰为爱好；不声称从事有偿设计工作。

facts.en: Collected supplier quotes and purchase requests; the centre manager approved spending.
facts.zh: 收集供应商报价和采购请求；中心经理审批开支。

facts.en: Prepared post-event feedback summaries without retaining participant contact details in shared reports.
facts.zh: 编制活动后反馈摘要，共享报告不保留参与者联系方式。

facts.en: A planning note lists 120 visitors at the history event, but the retained sign-in sheet contains 93 entries and walk-in counting is unclear.
facts.zh: 一份规划备注列出历史主题活动有 120 名访客，但留存签到表有 93 条记录，未预约来访者的计数方式不明。

facts.en: A draft profile calls the candidate certified in event safety; the only source is an attendance email for a briefing with no certificate attached.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿称候选人持有活动安全认证；唯一来源为说明会出席邮件，未附证书。

facts.en: No direct authority for permits, security deployment or emergency planning is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录对许可、安全人员部署或应急规划的直接权限。
